T4.2.message: Outside T4.2-T4.4: the Hindi notes for words.w2.notes.hi ('शब्दकोश गणेश को…') and words.w5.notes.hi ('शब्दकोश गवेन्द्र का अर्थ…') say the meaning comes from 'the dictionary', but the English notes do not. This is a visible attribution, which the editorial guide does not allow, and it makes the two languages differ. A human should decide whether to remove 'शब्दकोश'.
